PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.section1Text: HÁRPÁ values your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data shared through this form. We use your information exclusively to understand your needs, personalize our service, and offer experiences aligned with your interests.
PrivacyPolicy.section2Intro: By filling out this form, we may collect:
PrivacyPolicy.section2Item6: Preferences and information shared about the desired trip;
PrivacyPolicy.section2Item7: Other information provided voluntarily by you.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Intro: The collected data may be used to:
PrivacyPolicy.section3Item1: Get in touch regarding your request;
PrivacyPolicy.section3Item5: Comply with legal and regulatory obligations.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Outro: We will not use your information for purposes incompatible with those described in this Policy.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Text1: Your data may be shared only when necessary to enable the requested service, including strategic partners, service providers, or competent authorities, always in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Text2: We do not sell or trade your personal data to third parties.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Text1: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure, or improper destruction.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Text2: Data will be stored for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy or as required by law.
PrivacyPolicy.section6Intro: You may, at any time, request:
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item1: Confirmation of the existence of data processing;
PrivacyPolicy.section6Item3: Correction of incomplete or outdated information;
PrivacyPolicy.section7Text: For questions, requests, or to exercise your rights related to privacy and data protection, please contact us through the official channels provided by HÁRPÁ.

heading.description: Group journeys for those who seek authentic experiences, without giving up comfort and convenience.

whatAre.title: What are Group Expeditions?
whatAre.description: Group Expeditions are journeys with up to 10 participants, carefully organized by the HÁRPÁ team to provide an immersive, exclusive and authentic experience.

ownGroup.title: Can I put together my own group for a Group Expedition?
ownGroup.description: Yes! You can put together your own group of up to 10 participants and choose the expedition date. The HÁRPÁ team will organize the journey according to the group's preferences, ensuring a personalized and unique experience.

whyChoose.title: Why choose Group Expeditions?
whyChoose.description: Group Expeditions offer the opportunity to experience unique and memorable moments, sharing special times with other participants and relying on the HÁRPÁ team's expertise to ensure an unforgettable journey.

whatIs.title: What is the Private Experience?
whatIs.description: Private is a fully personalized experience. You choose the destination, dates, who joins you, and the pace of the trip. Based on your interests, the HÁRPÁ team crafts an exclusive journey, tailored just for you. If you'd like, you can use the entire Group Expedition itinerary and adapt it to your preferences.

guide.title: Does a guide accompany the Private trip?
guide.description: Not necessarily. Unlike the Group Expeditions, the Private option does not include in-person guidance during the trip. Even so, the HÁRPÁ team remains available 24/7 via WhatsApp for support, guidance and any adjustments along the way.

whyChoose.title: Why choose the Private Experience?
whyChoose.description: The Private experience is ideal for those seeking total freedom to travel at their own pace. With flexible dates, destinations of your choice and an itinerary designed exclusively around your interests, every journey is carefully planned to reflect what makes a trip truly special to you.
